title: Lotus Sutra Intro
speaker: Shuko Edie Norton
summary: The talk emphasizes the importance of skillful means in Buddhist teachings, highlighting how the Buddha adapts his message to suit different levels of understanding and achieve enlightenment for all beings. This approach is exemplified by the Lotus Sutra, which presents a nuanced and evolving understanding of reality, challenging traditional notions of beauty and human form. By embracing this concept of emptiness, we can move beyond limited perspectives and cultivate a deeper understanding of the interconnectedness of all phenomena.
